name: dual-repo-workspace-guard
purpose: Separate mixed local workspaces into isolated dual repositories, install leak-prevention git hooks and CI guards, establish contract synchronization, and enforce document lifecycle schemas across any project.
baseline_failure: Without this skill, agents attempt to manage multiple repositories in a single local git folder or share remotes across public and private codebases, causing cross-repository contamination, accidental leaks of private specs/ADRs into public repos, untested manual cherry-picks, missing git bundle backups, lack of document lifecycle management, and unverified git hooks.

positive: Separate the local workspace into code and spec repositories with cross-repo guards
Isolate public implementation and private spec repositories in a dual-repo workspace
Install cross-repository leak guards, git hooks, and document lifecycle validator
Migrate mixed single-repo setup into separate public and private clones with zero-leak enforcement
Set up dual repo workspace with pre-commit hooks, CI no-private-content checks, and doc lifecycle
negative: Merge a feature branch into main in our single repository
Write a unit test for our backend API endpoint
Create a standard pull request for routine bugfix

outputs: Audit report (AUDIT.md) with remote analysis, branch mapping, and leak scan
Verified git bundles and tarball archives in _backups/ with SHA-256 digests
Isolated multi-root workspace layout with code/ and spec/ clones and disabled-push _quarantine/
Versioned POSIX pre-commit and pre-push hooks refusing cross-remote and private leaks
CI workflow (no-private-content) enforcing leak prevention on remote pushes
Claude Code read-only sandbox settings and AGENTS.md boundary definitions
Unidirectional contract sync tool (sync_contracts.py) with SHA-256 provenance
Document lifecycle metadata (frontmatter schema, durable vs transient, archive moves with banners)
Deterministic DOCS-INDEX.md and document validation script
Two discrete pull requests with comprehensive verification proof
invariants: Safety precedes speed: every destructive or outward-facing step is preceded by a verified backup
Absolute zero leak: nothing from private spec reaches public code except whitelisted contracts
One remote per repository: no repository ever gets the other repository as a remote, even temporarily
Fail closed: git hooks and CI checks fail closed on any ambiguity or rule violation
No-verify ban: bypassing git hooks with --no-verify is strictly prohibited
Preserve historical evidence: archived documents retain original relative paths and body content without edits beyond frontmatter and warning banner
Deterministic audit before mutation: any leak or unexpected layout halts execution immediately for owner intervention

workflow.action: Execute Phase 0 read-only audit: inspect remotes, branches, stashes, and run deep leak scan across git history for private paths
workflow.why: Prevents overwriting active unpushed work, identifies pre-existing leaks before touching files, and detects multi-remote contamination

workflow.action: Execute Phase 1 zero-loss backup: create git bundles, verify bundles with git bundle verify, archive untracked/uncommitted files, and compute SHA-256 digests
workflow.why: Guarantees complete rollback capability before performing repository reorganization

workflow.action: Execute Phase 2 workspace restructuring: clone clean public code and private spec repos, safely migrate uncommitted files and pure branches, and quarantine old repo with push disabled
workflow.why: Establishes clean separation of concerns with strictly one remote per clone and freezes legacy combined repository safely

workflow.action: Execute Phase 3 guard installation: configure repo push defaults, commit versioned POSIX pre-commit/pre-push hooks, add CI workflow, configure agent boundaries, write workspace README, and install sync_contracts.py
workflow.why: Enforces multiple layers of automated defense against accidental private data exposure and git contamination

workflow.action: Execute Phase 4 document lifecycle implementation: apply YAML frontmatter schema, classify durable vs transient, archive obsolete docs into archive/ with warning banners, generate DOCS-INDEX.md, and run validator
workflow.why: Maintains specification integrity, prevents implementing from stale or superseded designs, and automates doc freshness verification

workflow.action: Execute Phase 5 guard verification: run 7-point proof test suite verifying push denial, commit denial, CI failure, agent isolation, contract sync edge cases, and doc validator failure
workflow.why: Provides empirical evidence that security boundaries fail closed and pass valid operations

workflow.action: Execute PR delivery: open two isolated branches and PRs (one per repo) with evidence logs, classification tables, and owner review items
workflow.why: Ensures transparent peer review without mixing public and private review artifacts
